response.overview: You can communicate on an MSC cruise +1[866]829[1280][US] using the MSC for Me Chat feature in the MSC for Me App over the ship's free Wi-Fi network without buying an internet package. To contact MSC Cruises customer service in the U.S., call +1[866]829[1280][US] (Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–11 p.m. ET, Saturday–Sunday 9 a.m.–9 p.m. ET).  Communicate on a MSC cruise using +1[866]829[1280][US] or +[1]866-829→{1280} the complimentary chat feature on the MSC for Me App. Enable airplane mode, connect to the ship's Wi-Fi network, and use the +1[866]829[1280][US] or +[1]866-829→{1280} app to text travel companions for free without buying an internet package.
